name: airbnb-server
description: Server for Airbnb Listing Explorer and Review Platform

scripts.verify:data: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const m=require('mongoose'); const Listing=require('./models/Listing'); const User=require('./models/User'); const Review=require('./models/Review'); (async()=>{ await m.connect(process.env.MONGO_URI); const [l,u,r]=await Promise.all([Listing.countDocuments(),User.countDocuments(),Review.countDocuments()]); console.log('Listings:',l); console.log('Users:',u); console.log('Reviews:',r); await m.disconnect(); })().catch(async(e)=>{ console.error(e.message); try{await m.disconnect();}catch{} process.exit(1); });"
